title: Guarded dependent index
contract: When the index is within the length-indexed array, access exactly that element; generated access must stay within bounds.
scope: Lengths 0..3, indices -1..3; arrays contain their indices; admission 0<=i<n.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Generated index is within array bounds.
Returned value equals requested element under the admission condition.

variants.description: Compute same index by decrementing n-(n-i).
